methodology.latestStatus: Last completed observation in the chronological run list; repeated executions do not create new unique tests.
methodology.observationSources: Only explicit XCTest Test Case finished lines in listed logs. Run status is retrieved independently with gh run list.
methodology.important: Latest pass per unique test is not a claim that all tests passed in one run or against the same commit.
methodology.optionalLogs: Final iPhone 13 and device layout logs are parsed only when their files exist; only completed Test Case lines create observations.
methodology.layoutCounting: Mini/Pro device repetitions are stored separately; their six planned executions do not add unique iPhone 13 scenarios.

measurements.caveat: Single CI request per live scenario/run; launch metric has three repetitions per run. Not a guarantee of physical iPhone or mobile-network latency.
